title: CF Meet service token claims v1
description: Claims of an internal service token. The token proves which service sent a request; it never carries permissions: the receiving service grants permissions from its own trust policy. Receivers additionally enforce: aud equals the receiver's own identity; runtime_environment equals the receiver's own runtime environment; iss is bound to the signing key (kid); iat <= nbf < exp; exp - iat <= 300 seconds; 30 seconds maximum clock skew; request_id and correlation_id equal the X-CF-Request-Id and X-CF-Correlation-Id headers. The claim set is closed: unknown claims are rejected.

aud.description: Exactly one receiving service identity. Arrays and wildcards are not permitted.

delegated_context.description: Optional safe customer/application/actor context asserted by the issuing service.

bnd.description: Request binding version (SEC-012). Present together with htm and htu, or not at all.

htu.description: Bound request path in canonical form: path only (no scheme, host, query or fragment), starting with '/', escapes of unreserved characters decoded and other escapes in upper-case hex, no dot or empty segments, trailing slash significant, at most 1024 bytes. The pattern checks the character set; the full rule is canonical_request_path in packages/service-auth/src/binding.rs.
